40010398.author: पदार्थः
40010398.content: इति this, तारया by Tara, प्रश्रितम् courteous, धर्मसंहितम् justifiable, वाक्यम् words, उक्तः having been told, मृदुस्वभावः of gentle nature, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, तत् that, वचः word, प्रतिजग्राह accepted.

40010398.author: Translation
40010398.content: Thus the gentlenatured Saumitri accepted Tara's courteous words sanctioned by dharma.

40010399.author: पदार्थः
40010399.content: तस्मिन् when such, वाक्ये words, प्रतिगृहीते were accepted, हरिगणेश्वरः leader of the vanara clan, लक्ष्मणात् from Lakshmana, सुमहत् great, त्रासम् fear, क्लिन्नम् wet, वस्त्रमिव like a garment, अत्यजत् cast aside.

40010399.author: Translation
40010399.content: Sugriva, king of the vanara clan, cast aside his great fear when Lakshmana accepted the words of Tara just as one discards a wet garment from the body.

40010400.author: पदार्थः
40010400.content: ततः then, वानरेश्वरः lord of vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, कण्ठगतम् worn on the neck, चित्रम् colourful, बहुगुणम् valuable, महत् great, माल्यम् garland, चिच्छेद tore off, विमदश्च relieved (from drunkenness), आसीत् got free.

40010400.author: Translation
40010400.content: Thereupon Sugriva, relieved from his drunken state tore off the great, colourful valuable garland worn on his neck.

40010401.author: पदार्थः
40010401.content: सर्ववानरसत्तमः the noble of all the vanaras, सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, भीमबलम् a man of great prowess, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, सम्प्रहर्षयन् pleasing manner, प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् these polite words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40010401.author: Translation
40010401.content: Sugriva, the noblest of all monkeys, spoke these polite words in a pleasing manner to Lakshmana of terrific strength:

40010402.author: पदार्थः
40010402.content: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, प्रणष्टा lost from me, श्री:च prosperity also, कीर्ति: च and fame, शाश्वतम् permanent, कपिराज्यं च and the kingdom of monkeys, इदम् this, रामप्रसादात् by the grace of Rama, मया by me, पुनः again, प्राप्तम् has been regained.

40010402.author: Translation
40010402.content: 'O Saumitri my prosperity, fame and the permanent sovereignty of vanaras had been lost. It was  regained by the grace of Rama.

40010403.author: पदार्थः
40010403.content: अरिन्दम crusher of enemies, स्वेन his own, कर्मणा by deeds, ख्यातस्य of a famed, देवस्य lord's, तस्य his, शक्तः is possible, कः who, प्रतिकर्तुम् ever to repay, तादृशम् such, विक्रमं वीर heroic valour.

40010403.author: Translation
40010403.content: 'O crusher of enemies  how is it possible to repay the famous lord Rama's valour (in killing Vali)?

40010404.author: पदार्थः
40010404.content: धर्मात्मा राघवः righteous Rama, सहायमात्रेण only be an assistant, मया by me, स्वेन तेजसा by his own fiery energy, सीताम् Sita, प्राप्स्यति he will get back, रावणम् Ravana,वधिष्यति च he will  kill.

40010404.author: Translation
40010404.content: 'Righteous Rama can merely restore Sita with my assistance. By his own fiery energy he will kill Ravana.

40010405.author: पदार्थः
40010405.content: येन by whomsoever, सप्त seven, महाद्रुमाः huge trees, शैलश्च mountain too, वसुधा चैव and earth also, एकेन by only one, बाणेन with an arrow, दारिताः shattered, तस्य to him, सहायकृत्यम् assistance to be done, किम् what.

40010405.author: Translation
40010405.content: 'Rama shattered seven huge trees, a mountain and earth with a single arrow. What assistance does he need?

40010406.author: पदार्थः
40010406.content: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, धनुः bow, विष्फारयानस्य  with the twang of his bow, यस्य its, शब्देन by the sound, सशैला: even the mountains, भूमिः earth, कम्पिता was shaken तस्य his, सहायैः assistance, किं why?

40010406.author: Translation
40010406.content: 'O Lakshmana the twang of his bow shook even the mountains and the earth. What assistance does he need?

40010407.author: पदार्थः
40010407.content: नरर्षभ O bull among men, सपुरस्सरम् along with his followers, वैरिणम् the enemy, रावणम् Ravana, हन्तुम् to kill, गच्छतः while going, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, अहम् I, अनुयात्राम् following, करिष्ये I shall.

40010407.author: Translation
40010407.content: 'O Lakshmana, bull among men I shall only join him along with others when he leads the army to kill Ravana.

40010408.author: पदार्थः
40010408.content: विश्वासात् due to faith, प्रणयेन वा or with love, किञ्चित् even a little, अतिक्रान्तं यदि have exceeded time, प्रेष्यस्य of a servant, मे my, क्षमितव्यम् one should pardon, कश्चित् any one, नापराध्यति इति न is not flawless in the world.

40010408.author: Translation
40010408.content: 'If I have committed even a little transgression in my faith in Rama or affection for him and exceeded the time limit, my mistakes are to be excused as one would pardons a servant. No one is flawless in the world.'

40010409.author: पदार्थः
40010409.content: महात्मनः of the great self, तस्य his, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, इति thus, ब्रुवाणस्य of him while speaking, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रीतः अभवत् was happy, प्रेम्णा with affection, च also, एवम् in this way, उवाच ह spoke.

40010409.author: Translation
40010409.content: Lakshmana who was happy to hear great Sugriva replied affectionately:

40010410.author: पदार्थः
40010410.content: वानरेश्वर O king of monkeys, सुग्रीव Sugriva, नाथेन by a king, विशेषतः specially, प्रश्रितेन by a courteous one, त्वया you, मम my, भ्राता brother, सर्वथा in all ways, सनाथः हि has a guardian.

40010410.author: Translation
40010410.content: 'O Sugriva, king of monkeys when you are extending due courtesy to my brother,he has a guardian in you by all means.

40010411.author: पदार्थः
40010411.content: सुग्रीव Sugriva, ते your, यः whatever, प्रभावः power, आर्जवम् straightforward nature, यत्  such, शौचं च purity, त्वम् your, कपिराज्यस्य of vanara kingdom, अनुत्तमाम् excellent, श्रियम् prosperity, भोक्तुम् to enjoy, अर्हः you deserve.

40010411.author: Translation
40010411.content: 'You are powerful and straightforward by nature.You are humble and noble. Therefore, you deserve the high prosperity of the kingdom of the monkeys.

40010412.author: पदार्थः
40010412.content: सुग्रीव Sugriva, सहायेन with you as associate, त्वया by your, प्रतापवान् valiant hero, रामः Rama, शत्रून्  enemies, रणे in war, अचिरात् shortly, वधिष्यति he will kill, संशयः is doubt, न not, अत्र in this case

40010412.author: Translation
40010412.content: 'O Sugriva with you as associate, valiant hero Rama will kill his enemies in war very soon. There is no doubt about it.

40010413.author: पदार्थः
40010413.content: सुग्रीव Sugriva, धर्मज्ञस्य  who is aware of dhrama, कृतज्ञस्य of a grateful one, सङ्ग्रामेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनः of one who does not retreat, तव your, भाषितम् word, उपपन्नम्  true, युक्तं च is fitting also.

40010413.author: Translation
40010413.content: 'O Sugriva you know dharma.You are grateful and will not turn back from the battle. So your words are true and befitting.

40010414.author: पदार्थः
40010414.content: वानरसत्तम best of monkeys, मम my, ज्येष्ठम् elder brother, त्वां च and you, वर्जयित्वा with the exception of, अन्यः others, कः who, सामर्थ्ये सति capability, दोषज्ञः knows the faults of others, भाषितुम् to speak, अर्हति will be capable.

40010414.author: Translation
40010414.content: 'O best of monkeys barring you and my elder brother, who else would be capable of speaking this way about themselves even when you are aware of other's faults?

40010415.author: पदार्थः
40010415.content: हरिपुङ्गव Sugriva, दैवतैः by deities, चिराय for a long time, दत्तः given, सहायः as helper, विक्रमेण बलेन च in power and valour, रामस्य with Rama, सदृशः equal, असि you are.

40010415.author: Translation
40010415.content: 'You who are equal to Rama in valour and strength, will continue to be the gift of gods to us for long.

40010416.author: पदार्थः
40010416.content: किं तु nevertheless, त्वम् you, मया सह with me, इतः from this place, शीघ्रम् at once, निष्क्रम start, भार्याहरणकर्शितम् a man grieved by the abduction of his wife, वयस्य your friend, सान्त्वयस्व reassure.

40010416.author: Translation
40010416.content: 'Nevertheless I want you to proceed from here with me at once and reassure your friend who is agrieved due to the abduction of his wife.

40010417.author: पदार्थः
40010417.content: त्वम् You, शोकाभिभूतस्य of a griefstricken man, रामस्य भाषितम् Rama's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मया by me, त्वम् you, परुषाणि harshly, उक्तः इति यत् thus spoken, अर्हसि you will, तच्च that, क्षन्तुम् to forgive.

40010417.author: Translation
40010417.content: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामयणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysix sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
